format: C++ (Tensor Library / Native Backend code for PyTorch)
description: This file contains implementations related to batch linear algebra operations in PyTorch's ATen native library, including function prototypes, meta functions for shape inference, and wrappers for LAPACK and BLAS routines used in batched linear algebra computations such as solving linear systems, eigendecomposition, SVD, Cholesky, and LU factorization.
external_files: Various <ATen/ops/...> headers (e.g., _spsolve, _cholesky_solve_helper, linalg_eigh, linalg_svd, etc.) depending on operator headers included
